html:
Hello, here is an image of the Heart Nebula (IC 1805) and NGC 896 in the upper right corner. This emission nebula is located in the constellation Cassiopeia.


 
For this photo, here are the technical parameters
Date:  2010/09/11
Optical train = Takahashi Sky90 + f4.5 reducer - IDAS-LPS filter - Canon xsi unfiltered
Mount: Takahashi EM-200 Temma II driven with the SkyVoyager software via Skyfi
Site: At home
19 exposures of 10 min for 190 minutes
Dark, flat and bias applied
DeepSkyStacker + PhotoShop
Guided with Kwik Guider and the Phd software
